scenes.say: Three milky coffees. One easy test.
Mak-kee-ah-toh means marked. Espresso, plus a dollop of foam.
Cortado means cut. Steamed milk cuts the espresso, about half and half.
Cappuccino has the most milk. Thick foam makes it sweeter and creamier.
A dollop, then half, then the most.
Foam, half, or full milk. Save this for your next order.
